criteria.criterion: 1. Isolated local stack and current app at the real library/auth web entrypoints, synthetic data; remote paused; exact commit/build and config recorded without credentials
criteria.action: scripts/local-supabase.sh reset (CLI 2.33.9, postgres 15.8.1.069, 14/14 migrations + seed) then scripts/pbk30-verify.sh all: next build/next start for /auth, /auth/signup, /auth/forgot-password, /auth/reset-password, /library; next dev for dev mode
criteria.expected: clean reproducible stack; all repo migrations apply unmodified; app reachable at real entrypoints
criteria.observed: reset exit 0; 'database image: supabase/postgres:15.8.1.069'; 'migrations applied: 14 / 14'; app served from the production build; dev mode passes after D2/D3 fixes
criteria.platform: Linux cloud container + GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest (CI job web-local-supabase)
limitations: Clean reproducibility relies on the documented image pin, not on editing applied migrations; see docs/local-supabase.md
In this container realtime needed a local IPv4 rebuild (kernel has no IPv6); GitHub runners do not

criteria.criterion: 2. Change one metadata field and reload: highlights, bookmarks, TOC, recommendations intact; spectrum/rating/wishlist persist without column errors; a second recommendation keeps the first
criteria.action: e2e/local-supabase/c2-metadata.spec.ts: UI edit Publisher -> reload; DB deep-equality of metadata arrays and highlights-table rows; keyboard slider steps; Home -> 0; wishlist priority + typed notes; add recommendation
criteria.expected: UI shows the edit after reload and the DB arrays/rows are unchanged; 0.8/1.5, 0, priority 4 and the note persist; recommendations [One, Two]
criteria.observed: 5/5 pass on 8a54d13 and a483199; baseline (unfixed product code) 0/5

criteria.criterion: 3. Upload one EPUB/PDF; mixed bulk queue with a controlled failing file: retrievable books, displayed outcomes match persisted successes/failures, failed items recoverable; wishlist CSV rows persist after reload
criteria.action: c3-uploads.spec.ts: manual EPUB (SHA-256 of the downloaded file); bulk queue of 2 PDFs + duplicate-title EPUB + .txt with a single injected storage 500 (Playwright route, labelled fault injection); retry; remove the duplicate; CSV with 3 valid rows + 1 without a title
criteria.expected: .txt rejected with a message; toast '1 uploaded, 2 failed'; DB rows and storage objects match; failures listed with reasons; retry -> '1 uploaded, 1 failed'; no orphans; CSV toast 'Imported 3 of 4 rows' and 3 wishlist rows after reload

criteria.criterion: 4. Local synthetic accounts + email capture under next build/next start: reset link reaches /auth/reset-password and resets; pending sign-up lands at /auth/verify-email; invalid/expired link fails intelligibly without changing another account
criteria.action: c4-auth.spec.ts with Mailpit: sign-up -> verify-email -> emailed confirm link; forgot-password -> emailed link -> reset form -> new password; spent and tampered links opened while another account is signed in
criteria.expected: verify-email page, unconfirmed account cannot sign in until confirmed; reset page stays (no /library redirect), new password works, old one fails, bystander unchanged; invalid link shows 'invalid or has expired' and no password changes
criteria.observed: 3/3 pass on 8a54d13 and a483199; baseline: sign-up and valid reset passed (PR #13 fixes verified), invalid link failed (no explanation, D7). Separate repro: submitting the form after a spent link did NOT change the signed-in account (auth-js drops the session on URL errors)
criteria.platform: Linux, Chromium, production build, local GoTrue + Mailpit

local_verification_required: Coordinator (Windows/WSL): scripts/local-supabase.sh reset on a disposable stack, then PBK30_DISPOSABLE=1 scripts/pbk30-verify.sh all; expect the same 11 + 2 + 1 passes.

Owner's existing local stack (not disposable): do NOT run with PBK30_DISPOSABLE=1. If it was created by an older CLI or with manual steps, check `scripts/local-supabase.sh status`; a stack on a newer postgres image needs `reset` (destroys local data) to adopt the pin.
Smoke at the owner's real entrypoint: npm run dev against the local stack; dev mode shows the library without RLS errors.
review_walkthrough: npm run build && start against the stack (or pbk30-verify.sh build/before): sign in as a synthetic user, open a book's Details, edit Publisher, reload: highlights/recommendations intact (criterion 2).
Upload Book -> Bulk Upload with a PDF, a duplicate title and a .txt: rejection toast, 'N uploaded, M failed', failed rows keep their reasons, 'Retry N failed' (criterion 3).
Forgot password -> Mailpit (http://127.0.0.1:54324) link -> reset form; open the same link again -> 'invalid or has expired' (criterion 4).
